correctness.rationale: Explicit Laplacian representation exhausts four symmetry sectors; after orthogonal multiplicity weighting the 2x2 antisymmetric block is symmetric. Unit spectral gap is equivalent to kc>1, ka+mc>=1, and 2b(kc-1)>=(k+m)c-1. Remaining eigenblocks follow automatically; minimizing positive coefficient budget gives exactly F(t) and its strictly convex 3-regime minimizer. Concavity of lambda2 verifies global symmetry averaging, and nonnegative orbit averages establish claimed zeros for every optimizer. Numerical full-Laplacian replay on 156 integer pairs is consistent but not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The problem models cost-efficient equal-sized communities with several independent gateway bridges. The result is an exact global allocation rule for all k>=2 and m>=1, including a nontrivial intermediate regime and a sharp ratio threshold where interior gateway-clique conductances become necessary. The zero-rate theorem holds for every optimum, not just a symmetric design, and exposes resource placement transitions absent from fixed-layer coupling formulations.
